data.markdown:
Pipeline CRM alternatives comparison hub. Compare Pipeline CRM ($25 to $49/user/mo billed annually, named Highest User Adoption by G2) to 11 competitors: Pipedrive, Salesforce, HubSpot, Close, Copper, Pipeliner, Zoho, Asana, SuiteCRM, Nutshell, and Monday CRM. Side-by-side pricing, features, and support quality comparisons. Pipeline CRM specializes in construction, manufacturing, and professional services with US-based support rated 9.2/10 on G2. Free 14-day trial, no credit card required.

CRM COMPARISON HUB

# Pipeline CRM Alternatives & Comparisons

Choosing the right CRM matters. We’ve compared Pipeline CRM to the most popular alternatives side by side — real pricing, real features, real user reviews. No spin, just the data you need to make a confident decision for your sales team.

[Book a demo](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/schedule_demo) [Start a free trial](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/signup)

✓ No credit card required
✓ 14-day free trial
✓ Cancel anytime


## How Does Pipeline CRM Compare?

At-a-glance comparison of pricing, ratings, and ideal use cases across leading CRM platforms.

| CRM | Starting Price | Most Popular Plan | G2 Rating | Support Score | Best For |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pipeline CRM | $25/user/mo (billed annually) | $49/user/mo (Grow, billed annually) | Highest User Adoption (G2) | 9.2/10 | Construction, manufacturing, SMB sales teams |
| Pipedrive | $14/user/mo | $49/user/mo (Professional) | 4.3/5 (1,900 reviews) | 8.3/10 | Activity-based selling, startups |
| HubSpot Sales Hub | Free (paid from $15/seat/mo) | $90/seat/mo (Professional) | [4.4/5 (12,000 reviews)](https://www.g2.com/products/hubspot-sales-hub/reviews) | 8.5/10 | Marketing + sales alignment, inbound |
| Salesforce | $25/user/mo | $80/user/mo (Enterprise) | [4.4/5 (20,000 reviews)](https://www.g2.com/products/salesforce-salesforce-sales-cloud/reviews) | 8.2/10 | Enterprise, complex workflows |
| Close | $35/user/mo | $99/user/mo (Growth) | 4.7/5 (970 reviews) | 9.1/10 | Outbound calling, inside sales |
| Copper | $9/user/mo | $59/user/mo (Professional) | 4.5/5 (1,200 reviews) | 8.5/10 | Google Workspace-native teams |
| Zoho CRM | $14/user/mo | $40/user/mo (Enterprise) | 4.1/5 (2,700 reviews) | 7.8/10 | Suite bundling, budget-first buyers |
| SuiteCRM | Free (self-hosted) | ~$165/mo flat (Hosted Starter) | 4.2/5 (91 reviews) | ~7.0/10 | Technical teams, open-source, self-hosted |
| Nutshell | $13/user/mo | $59/user/mo (Business) | 4.3/5 (1,408 reviews) | 8.6/10 | Small teams needing basic CRM at low entry cost |
| Monday CRM | $12/seat/mo (3-seat min) | $28/seat/mo (Pro) | 4.6/5 (906 reviews) | ~8.0/10 | Teams already on Monday.com, cross-department workflows |

Pricing verified March 2026. G2 ratings as of March 2026.

## CRM Comparison Pages

Detailed side-by-side comparisons with pricing breakdowns, feature tables, use-case scenarios, and real user reviews.

[![Pipedrive logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Pipedrive_Logo_Green-2.svg)**Pipedrive vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Both offer visual pipeline management for SMBs. A 10-user team on Pipeline CRM Grow costs $490/mo vs Pipedrive Professional at $490/mo — but Pipeline CRM includes dedicated US-based support (9.2/10 G2) vs Pipedrive’s 8.3/10.\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/pipedrive-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Salesforce logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/salesforce-with-type-logo-1.svg)**Salesforce vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Enterprise CRM vs purpose-built simplicity. Pipeline CRM costs up to 90% less with no admin overhead or mandatory consulting. Built for 5–50 person sales teams who need results, not complexity.\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/salesforce-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![HubSpot logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/HSLogo_color-1.svg)**HubSpot vs Pipeline CRM** \\
HubSpot’s free tier is tempting, but Professional costs $90/seat/mo plus a mandatory $1,500 onboarding fee. Pipeline CRM Grow gives full sales features at $49/user/mo with no mandatory onboarding fees and CSV/Excel data import. Same G2 rating (4.4), better support (9.2 vs 8.5).\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/hubspot-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Close CRM logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/66267ac89a71da7e5c4cc963_logo-dark-nav-1.svg)**Close vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Close excels at power and predictive dialing, SMS, and voicemail drop for high-velocity outbound teams. Pipeline CRM wins on pricing (Grow $49/user vs Close Growth $99/user for comparable automation), industry workflows for construction and manufacturing, and US-based live chat support rated 9.2/10 on G2.\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/close-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Copper CRM logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/copper_logo.svg)**Copper vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Copper requires Google Workspace and caps contacts at 15,000 on its $59/seat Professional plan. Pipeline CRM works with any email provider, includes unlimited contacts, and leads Copper on support quality (9.2 vs 8.2 on G2).\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/copper-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Pipeliner CRM logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/pipeliner_logo.svg)**Pipeliner vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Don’t confuse the names. Pipeliner CRM targets larger teams with complex org charts. Pipeline CRM is built for 5–50 person sales teams with simpler pricing, faster setup, and US-based human support.\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/pipeliner-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Zoho CRM logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/zoho-crm-logo.svg)**Zoho CRM vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Zoho bundles 50+ apps but charges extra for premium support. Pipeline CRM focuses on one thing: helping sales teams close deals, with dedicated US-based support included in every plan. G2 support: 9.2 vs Zoho’s 8.0.\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/zoho-crm-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Asana logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Asana_logo-1.svg)**Asana vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Asana is a project management tool, not a CRM. If your team needs deal tracking, sales forecasting, email drip campaigns, and pipeline visualization, Pipeline CRM is purpose-built for sales.\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/asana-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Suite CRM logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Suite-CRM.png)**SuiteCRM vs Pipeline CRM** \\
SuiteCRM is open-source and free, but requires self-hosting, developer maintenance, and has no dedicated support. Pipeline CRM is cloud-hosted, zero-maintenance, with US-based live chat support rated 9.2/10 on G2.\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/suite-crm-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Nutshell CRM logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Logo.png)**Nutshell vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Both target SMBs, but Pipeline CRM offers deeper customization and industry expertise for construction, manufacturing, and field sales — plus Map Views and route planning that Nutshell lacks.\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/nutshell-vs-pipeline-crm/) [![Monday CRM logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/monday-crm-logo.png)**Monday CRM vs Pipeline CRM** \\
Monday CRM is a Work OS that added CRM as a module. Pipeline CRM is purpose-built for sales. Monday’s $12/seat looks cheap, but the 3-seat minimum and feature gating means most teams need Pro at $84/mo minimum. Pipeline CRM starts at $25/user with no seat minimum and includes US-based live chat support (9.2/10 G2).\\
Read full comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/monday-vs-pipeline-crm/)

**Looking for project management?** Pipeline CRM includes a built-in [Project Management module](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/project-management/) on Grow and above, so you can track post-close delivery without a second tool.

## Why Sales Teams Choose Pipeline CRM

The features that set Pipeline CRM apart from the competition.

### Customization That Fits Your Process

Up to 25 custom fields, conditional formatting, and flexible pipelines that adapt to how your team actually sells — no developer required.

[Learn more →](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/account-customization/)

### Automation Without Complexity

Workflow automation, email sequences, and deal routing that save hours per week — set up in minutes, not months.

[Learn more →](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/automations/)

### Email Drip Campaigns Built In

Nurture leads with automated email sequences, open tracking, and click analytics — all included in your CRM, no third-party tool needed.

[Learn more →](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/email/)

## Pipeline CRM Alternatives — FAQs

Get answers to common questions about Pipeline CRM and how it compares.

What makes Pipeline CRM different from other CRMs?

Pipeline CRM is purpose-built for small sales teams (5–50 people) in industries like [construction](https://pipelinecrm.com/industries/construction-crm/), [manufacturing](https://pipelinecrm.com/industries/manufacturing-crm/), and [professional services](https://pipelinecrm.com/industries/professional-services-crm/). If you need a CRM that works out of the box without admin overhead → Pipeline CRM sets up in hours, not weeks. Transparent pricing starts at [$25/user/mo](https://pipelinecrm.com/pricing/) with US-based live chat support rated 9.2/10 on G2.

How much does Pipeline CRM cost compared to alternatives?

Pipeline CRM offers three plans: Start ($25/user/mo), Develop ($33/user/mo), and Grow ($49/user/mo) with annual billing. A 10-user team on Grow costs $490/mo. If you’re comparing: HubSpot Professional costs $90/seat/mo, Salesforce Professional is $80/user/mo, and Pipedrive Professional is $49/user/mo. No mandatory onboarding fees; data import included on every plan. See [full pricing](https://pipelinecrm.com/pricing/).

Can I migrate from another CRM to Pipeline CRM?

Yes. Pipeline CRM offers [data import](https://pipelinecrm.com/crm-data-migration/) that typically completes within 3 business days using CSV/Excel from your current CRM. If you need guided setup → [onboarding training](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/onboarding-services/) starts at $750 (Standard) or $1,500 (Premium). Start with a [14-day free trial](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/signup) to test the migration.

Which industries is Pipeline CRM best suited for?

Pipeline CRM serves [construction](https://pipelinecrm.com/industries/construction-crm/), [manufacturing](https://pipelinecrm.com/industries/manufacturing-crm/), [professional services](https://pipelinecrm.com/industries/professional-services-crm/), HVAC, landscaping, and logistics companies. If you’re in field sales → Pipeline CRM’s Map Views, route planning, and project-based deal tracking are purpose-built for your workflow. Over 18,000 businesses use Pipeline CRM across these verticals.

Does Pipeline CRM offer a free trial?

Yes. Pipeline CRM offers a [14-day free trial](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/signup) on the Grow plan (full features) with no credit card required. You get unlimited seats during the trial, plus a 30-day money-back guarantee after subscribing. If you want a personalized walkthrough → [book a demo](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/schedule_demo) with the team.

How does Pipeline CRM’s support compare to other CRMs?

Pipeline CRM’s support is rated 9.2/10 on G2 (Quality of Support) — higher than Pipedrive (8.3/10), Salesforce (8.2/10), and HubSpot (8.5/10). Every plan includes US-based live chat support. If you need enterprise-level support without enterprise pricing → Pipeline CRM delivers 97.6% customer satisfaction with <1 minute average chat response time.

Is Pipeline CRM better than Salesforce for small businesses?

If you’re a 5–50 person sales team → Pipeline CRM is simpler and up to 90% cheaper than Salesforce. You won’t need a dedicated Salesforce admin. If you need complex multi-department workflows, deep customization via Apex code, or AppExchange apps → Salesforce is the better fit. [See the full Salesforce comparison](https://pipelinecrm.com/comparison/salesforce-vs-pipeline-crm/).
